pages.title: Channel of Ra
pages.text: The $(gold)Solar Spire$() is a sacred structure that channels the power of $(deity)Ra$() to cleanse cursed land. When activated, it purifies a large area and provides lasting protection.

pages.title: Solar Spire Plinth
pages.text: The base of the spire. Place this first. It anchors the structure to the earth.

pages.title: Solar Spire Crucible
pages.text: The middle section. Place atop the plinth. Holds the sacred fire of Ra.

pages.title: Solar Spire Pyramidion
pages.text: The capstone. Place atop the crucible. Focuses solar energy to initiate cleansing. Right-click with $(item)Eye of Apophis$() to activate.

pages.title: Activation & Purification
pages.text: Right-click the pyramidion with an $(item)Eye of Apophis$() to activate the spire. It will process blocks in waves, cleansing all cursed earth, stone, sand, and corrupted plants within a large radius.$(br2)The spire also removes cursed entities like the $(curse)Khamsin$() and restores original blocks.

pages.title: Protection Zones
pages.text: When activated, the Solar Spire creates protection zones around itself that prevent curse from spreading. These zones persist even after cleansing completes, making the spire valuable for long-term land defense.
